name: Drum Music of the World
subtitle: Steelpan, Kulintang & more
shortDescription: 10 percussion instruments and rhythms to play: Steelpan, Bandoneon and tango rhythm, Kulintang and Carillon.
longDescription:
Drum Music of the World: 10 percussion instruments and rhythms from 20 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Steelpan, Bandoneon and tango rhythm, Kulintang, Carillon, Bodhrán, Tabla bols, Mbira, Balafon Gourd Xylophone, Calabash Water Drum and Isukuti drum dance.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can play instruments and dances, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
